messages.subject: Project Lyra - SSA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Please find attached our mark-up of the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement. The main changes:

- Founder cap increased from 2x to 3x (clause 9.1)
- De minimis raised to £50,000 and the basket to £200,000 (clause 9.2)
- General survival extended from 24 to 30 months
- Carve-out so Marisdale can identify the investment in its portfolio disclosures (clause 12.2)

We think these are market for a round of this size. Happy to discuss.

Kind regards,
David
